observation: Friction levels below the minimum in some runway sections; corrective measures required to restore the minimum friction levels.
reference: KSIA Asset Performance and Condition Assessment Report, March 2025 (audit 17 to 18 March 2025)

observation: Service road surface: expansion joints need repair or replacement to bring the roads to the Acceptable level.
reference: KSIA Asset Performance and Condition Assessment Report, March 2025 (audit 17 to 18 March 2025)

observation: Switchgear annual maintenance reports inadequate: do not show all required checks on VCB, protection & auxiliary relays, panels and busbars.
reference: KSIA Asset Performance and Condition Assessment Report, March 2025 (audit 17 to 18 March 2025)

observation: No diesel cut-out fuse installed on any of the generators at KSIA, a safety requirement for cutting out the fuel supply in case of fire. Signs of oil leaks on the floor in some airside substations pose a fire hazard. Maintenance records provided run to March 2024; compliance with the maintenance procedures to be ensured through weekly off-load tests, monthly on-load tests and annual service of the generators.
reference: KSIA Asset Performance and Condition Assessment Report, March 2025 (audit 17 to 18 March 2025)

observation: Switchgear and generators, which are central to the functioning of the distribution network, have Unacceptable tolerance levels; the distribution system is rated Tolerable until those findings are closed.
reference: KSIA Asset Performance and Condition Assessment Report, March 2025 (audit 17 to 18 March 2025)

observation: TRF 02 at AS1 is off due to oil below the minimum threshold. Transformer internal condition analysis indicates normal operation for the majority of transformers, excluding the AS4 substation transformers (TRF 01 and TRF 02), which indicate partial discharges, and the Basement Chamber A1 substation transformers (TRF 04 and TRF 05), which indicate a high-range thermal fault (above 700 °C). Production rates to be monitored within the next two months.
reference: KSIA Asset Performance and Condition Assessment Report, March 2025 (audit 17 to 18 March 2025)

observation: RWY 06 GP (glide path) transmitter 1 found unserviceable; ILS downgraded to CAT I operations. ILS flight inspection report to be checked.
reference: KSIA Asset Performance and Condition Assessment Report, March 2025 (audit 17 to 18 March 2025)

observation: Latest AWOS calibration records not submitted.
reference: KSIA Asset Performance and Condition Assessment Report, March 2025 (audit 17 to 18 March 2025)

observation: Fire detection and gaseous suppression systems well maintained according to the service stickers and in good service condition; faults observed on some of the panels need to be cleared.

observation: Quarterly preventive maintenance records for the previous two quarters submitted, confirming calibration of the machines. Of the sampled machines, one at international arrivals is not in good condition and one at local departures is not functional.

observation: People movers rated Unacceptable (escalators / travelators / lifts).

observation: Signs of corrosion; no structural assessment reports by Professional Engineers to rule out structural failure.
